% \includegraphics pictures in boxes that mirror or turn them over:
% \reflectbox at the natural size and with a width, \scalebox with
% negative factors (also halving, and turning over), two \reflectbox, a
% \reflectbox in a box that scales, and a mirrored picture in a link, a
% footnote, a table, a minipage, a theorem, italic text, and a figure. A
% picture turned over hangs below the baseline in the PDF, as graphics.sty
% swaps its height and depth.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
Bare: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={bare}]{test-picture.png}} after.

Width: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={width}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Half: \scalebox{-0.5}[0.5]{\includegraphics[alt={half}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Turned over: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={over}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Turned over bare: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={over bare}]{test-picture.png}} after.

Turned round: \scalebox{-1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={round}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Twice: \reflectbox{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={twice}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Nested: \scalebox{0.5}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={nested}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Link: \href{https://example.com}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={link}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Footnote.\footnote{In a note:
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={footnote}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.}

\begin{tabular}{|l|}
\hline
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={cell}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}} \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{minipage}{0.5\textwidth}
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={minipage}, width=\textwidth]{test-picture.png}}
\end{minipage}

\begin{theorem}
A picture: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={theorem}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.
\end{theorem}

\textit{In italic: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={italic}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.}

\begin{figure}
\centering
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={figure}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}
\caption{A mirrored picture.}
\end{figure}
\end{document}
